LanguageData.DMS_Formality_Strict.label: strict
LanguageData.DMS_Formality_Strict.description: Discipline, ceremony and military law are all part of keeping order. To break their forms is shameful.
LanguageData.DMS_Formality_Casual.label: casual
LanguageData.DMS_Formality_Casual.description: Rank is just a title. Ceremony is just procedure.
LanguageData.DMS_Formality_Contemptuous.label: contemptuous
LanguageData.DMS_Formality_Contemptuous.description: Military law is the oppressor's instrument of violence. To serve as the oppressor's executioner is shameful.
LanguageData.DMS_Operations_Venerated.label: venerated
LanguageData.DMS_Operations_Venerated.description: The unit exists to be used. A completed operation is the highest thing we do, and a failed one is a wound the whole colony carries. Fire support is not something to apologize for.
LanguageData.DMS_Operations_Necessary.label: necessary
LanguageData.DMS_Operations_Necessary.description: Nobody enjoys it. We do it because the alternative is worse, and we expect it to be done properly when it has to be done.
LanguageData.DMS_Operations_Abhorrent.label: abhorrent
LanguageData.DMS_Operations_Abhorrent.description: To call down fire on a target you cannot see is an abhorrent act. There is no telling what else is down there.
LanguageData.DMS_SealedTech_Venerated.label: venerated
LanguageData.DMS_SealedTech_Venerated.description: To unlock the unknown is the human instinct that drives progress.
LanguageData.DMS_SealedTech_Acceptable.label: acceptable
LanguageData.DMS_SealedTech_Acceptable.description: Sealed technology is useful, but its risks still deserve caution.
LanguageData.DMS_SealedTech_Forbidden.label: forbidden
LanguageData.DMS_SealedTech_Forbidden.description: Sealed technology was shelved for a reason, and we should never dig it back up.
LanguageData.DMS_SyntheticLife_Venerated.label: venerated
LanguageData.DMS_SyntheticLife_Venerated.description: Flesh is a first draft. What comes out of a gestation pod was designed on purpose, and what comes out of a reaction chamber is food that was designed on purpose too.
LanguageData.DMS_SyntheticLife_Acceptable.label: acceptable
LanguageData.DMS_SyntheticLife_Acceptable.description: It is equipment that happens to be wet. Nobody needs to have feelings about equipment.
LanguageData.DMS_SyntheticLife_Abhorrent.label: abhorrent
LanguageData.DMS_SyntheticLife_Abhorrent.description: A body is for carrying a person. Using one as a factory for something that was never going to be a person is the worst thing this technology has been put to, and eating what the same machines produce is not far behind.
